raw.chosen: Fix the three executable Cubic findings and retain historically accurate trajectory refs
raw.reasoning: Zero-delay retries, non-finite registry timeouts, and preserved-symlink entrypoints are valid edge cases. The two trajectory findings are not: every cited ref resolves to a commit and is an ancestor of the PR head, while replacing historical refs with the moving PR head would falsify when those trajectories were recorded.

retrospective.summary: Historical self-report of decisions about zero-delay verification retries, bounded registry query timeouts, preserved-symlink CLI execution, and historical trajectory refs. This trajectory captured no command, output, commit, changed-file, or test evidence, so all implementation and validation statements are non-authoritative and non-gating.
